question: Is the object of external touch-cognition located inside the inner touch field?
premises: The cognition presents an external touch.
That object is not situated within the inner abode of touch.
Its apparent externality must be explained otherwise.
inference: The object of external touch-cognition is not simply located inside the inner touch field.
uncertainties: The compound bahiḥspṛśonyākṣadhiyaḥ is dense and could be parsed with slight variation.
plain_english: The object of the cognition of an external touch is not located inside the inner field of touch.
